ui.title: The Old Courtyard
ui.lang.label: Language
hint.key_needed: The door is locked. You need a key.
narr.intro.male: He steps into the old courtyard.
narr.intro.female: She steps into the old courtyard.
narr.table: A dusty table stands in the corner. Something glints on it.
narr.glint_revealed: You lean closer. It's an old key.
narr.chest: An old wooden chest sits against the wall.
narr.door: A heavy wooden door blocks the way out.
dialogue.guard.acknowledge: {name}, is it? Not from around here, I'd wager.
dialogue.guard.why: I watch this door. It's locked, and I don't have the key.
dialogue.guard.key_hint: Try the merchant. He knows everything that happens in this courtyard.
dialogue.guard.repeat: Still here? Door's still locked, and I still don't have the key.
dialogue.merchant.key_pun: A key? Oh, I know a few keys — the one that opens doors, and the one that opens songs. Which one do you want?
dialogue.merchant.door_key: The one for the door? Then check the table over there. Saw something glinting on it earlier. Piece of cake.
dialogue.merchant.repeat: Back already? The table's over there, like I said.
msg.chest_opened: You open the chest. Coins glint inside.
msg.coin_edge: You flip a coin. It lands on its edge. Impressive.
msg.win: The old lock gives way. You step through the door. Well done, {name}.
item.old_key.name: Old Key
item.old_key.desc: A small brass key, warm to the touch.
